nina (PM): FYI I published the postmortem for the intermittent routing failure last night: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1862500000-routing-incident-brief. TL;DR: config drift + a partial control-plane rollout caused ~18m of elevated error rates for a subset of customers.
arsen (SRE): Added timeline and spike graphs. The rollout batch skipped a validation step and we saw mismatch in routing tables.
leo (Eng): I pushed a quick remediation to invalidate the bad config and rolled back the control-plane change. Will propose a preflight check.
claire (Support): Customer-facing note drafted in the doc under "communications"; sent to impacted accounts and support on-call.
nina (PM): Owners & next steps: 1) add preflight validation to the rollout tool -> @leo (due 2026-04-12). 2) add config-drift alert + dashboard -> @arsen (due 2026-04-10). 3) update runbook with rollback checklist -> @arsen (due 2026-04-09).
arsen (SRE): Ack, I'll add the alert and runbook changes today.
leo (Eng): I'll start the preflight PR and add unit tests for the validator.
status-bot: Postmortem published by nina (PM)  https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1862500000-routing-incident-brief (automated).
nina (PM): Scheduling a 20m follow-up to confirm closures: Mon 2026-04-13 09:30 PT. Invite sent. Please mark the owners table when you start work with :white_check_mark:.
_meta: postmortem announcement thread: brief link, TL;DR, owners, due dates, follow-up sync. Unique wording to avoid duplicates
